title: Dictionary entry
description: One dialect word or phrase. Stored at entries/{letter}/{id}.json; the file name must equal id and the folder must equal source.letter.

id.description: Unique slug: the source letter, a hyphen, then the headword in lower-case ASCII words joined by hyphens. Add -2, -3 for homographs. Must match the file name, e.g. a-are.

headword.description: The dialect word or phrase as it is spelled in the dictionary, without the article, e.g. are.

variants.description: Other dialect spellings or forms of the headword, e.g. a plural or a regional variant.

article.description: Dialect article recorded with the headword, e.g. lu, la, li, le.

pos.description: Part of speech as an Italian dictionary abbreviation, e.g. s.m., s.f., v., agg., avv., prep. art., pron., cong., pl.

pronunciation.description: Pronunciation hint written in plain letters, e.g. ajou. Not IPA.

locality.description: Towns or areas where this form is recorded, e.g. Montebello sul Sangro. Leave out when the word is general.

senses.description: Meanings of the headword, one object per meaning, most common first. Must not be empty unless tags includes needs-review.

it.description: Italian meaning. Plain text only: HTML and Markdown are shown literally.

en.description: English meaning. Plain text only. Put the part of speech in pos, not here.

enTranslateStatus.description: machine: unchecked machine translation, shown with an 'unverified' badge. reviewed: checked by a person.

notes.description: Short note about this meaning only, e.g. usage or register.

examples.description: Usage examples in dialect, with optional Italian and English translations.

abr.description: The example sentence in Abruzzese dialect.

en.description: English translation of the example, or null when there is none yet.

enTranslateStatus.description: machine: unchecked machine translation. reviewed: checked by a person.

etymology.description: Origin of the word, e.g. from Latin area.

grammarNotes.description: Longer explanations shown as a collapsed note under the meanings: grammar, usage, cultural or local background. One paragraph per item.

notes.description: Editorial notes for maintainers, such as the original source line when an entry was split or corrected.

tags.description: Maintenance flags. needs-review: the entry is incomplete or uncertain (allows empty senses). possible-duplicate: may repeat another entry.

source.description: Where the entry was taken from. Keep as scraped; it links readers to the original line and detects duplicates.

letter.description: Letter page of the source dictionary. Must match the entries/ folder and the first letter of id.

url.description: URL of the source letter page.

raw.description: The original source line, unchanged. Do not edit; correct the other fields instead.

rawHash.description: SHA-1 hex digest of raw. Must be unique across entries; update it only if raw changes.

scrapedAt.description: Date the source line was scraped, as YYYY-MM-DD.

contributors.description: GitHub usernames of people who edited this entry, e.g. Giovanni-Mattucci.
